system.name: Move Earth
system.description:
This spell allows the caster to cause soil, clay or sand – but not rock – to move horizontally or vertically in order to build a rampart or hill or to dig a hole or trench.

The caster can move soil at a rate of 60' per turn, and will usually be able to dig to a depth of 240' before reaching solid rock. Soil can only be dug and pushed around with this spell. It cannot be made into structures that won't support themselves.

When the duration expires, the soil stays where it is, although wind and rain may make it settle over the course of time.
